ko.description:
아삭아삭 당근, 쏙쏙 브로콜리, 톡톡 옥수수! 모모와 채소 친구들을 만나고 짧은 후렴을 따라 불러요.

2~4세 아이를 위한 세 단어: 당근 · 브로콜리 · 옥수수
화면에는 배우는 채소 이름만 나와요.

#모모타임 #동요 #채소동요 #당근 #브로콜리 #옥수수 #유아동요 #MomoTime

notes.reviewer: agent; no new individual user approval
notes.v_over_reason: Current short-song policy: reuse six approved non-lipsync sources, recut to the new song. No fixed spoken intro/outro.
approvals: 2026-11-27 agent visual review of ep03 approved sources; identity and moving food subjects suitable for current keyword-only production.

composition.style: Original Korean preschool singalong, cheerful acoustic swing shuffle at 118 BPM, major key. One clear light friendly female lead, natural child-friendly diction, small comfortable melodic range. Bouncy upright bass, brushed snare, handclaps, playful clarinet answers and light acoustic guitar. Catchy four-line hook with a rising three-note call and short descending answer, memorable separate phrases, sparse arrangement supporting the voice. Fully sung, not spoken or rap. Around 90 seconds, start singing within 2 seconds, concise sections, repeat supplied chorus, end with complete sung goodbye and 2-second resolved instrumental decay. No source melody or cover.

review_summary.song: Approved after official listening, stem alignment and melody-contour comparison. See music-review.json.

notes.validation_review: No validation errors. Legacy V/S/L and intro/narration warnings superseded by current song-only no-lipsync policy. Object-only close-ups intentionally have momo:false. Combined keywords are three food nouns separated by dots; no sentence captions.
notes.thumbnail_review: Initial three-word thumbnail obscured vegetables. Revised to one clear learning word above an unobstructed carrot close-up.
